sources.quote: Main stress is on the first vowel of a word. Other syllables in words of four or more syllables often carry some stress in order to avoid sequences of three or more unstressed syllables. Long vowels also tend to have some stress. Following a vowel with main stress, a single consonant tends to be lengthened. Nothing worthwhile can be said about intonation.
